# NS Pros Data API

The world's public data, one API.
License-cleared public data sources, normalized into a single REST API and MCP server for developers and AI agents.
Sources include the Japan Meteorological Agency, the World Bank, the US National Weather Service, Government of Canada open data, and UK data.gov.uk, spanning weather, health, finance, business, and public records.
New sources are added daily.
Only license-cleared sources (License Grade A: commercial redistribution confirmed) are offered.

## Base URL

https://api.nspros.ca

Catalog: https://api.nspros.ca/v1/sources (public — browsing the catalog needs no API key)

## Authentication

Header: Authorization: Bearer <key>
Get a key: https://data.nspros.ca/signup (free tier, issued immediately, no card required)
The same key works for REST and MCP.
Exception: GET /v1/sources (the catalog) is public and needs no key. A key is required to run queries.

## REST endpoints

- GET /v1/sources — list the catalog of available sources (public, no key required; supports q, category, and country filters)
- GET /v1/query/{source_id}?q=... — run a query against one source
- POST /v1/query — run a query with a JSON body: {"source_id": "...", "q": "..."}
- GET /v1/usage — check usage for the current key

All responses are JSON and automatically include source attribution.

## MCP

URL: https://api.nspros.ca/mcp
Auth: Authorization: Bearer <key>
Tools:
- search_sources — search the catalog
- query_source — run a query against a source by source_id
- get_usage — return usage for the current key

## Pricing

- Free: $0 — 1,000 requests/month, no card required
- Pay as you go: $1.99 per 1,000 requests
Note: signing up currently issues a free-tier key immediately. Pay-as-you-go billing will be connected via Stripe in the next step; until then no usage charges are billed.

## License policy

- Grade A: commercial redistribution confirmed — currently the only grade offered
- Grade B: BYO (bring your own upstream key) — planned for a later step, not offered yet
- Grade C: internal use only — not offered
- Grade D: on hold pending license review — not offered

## Limits and caching

- Per key: 120 requests/minute
- Per source: 30 requests/minute
- Responses are cached per source with a source-specific TTL

## Errors

- 401: missing or invalid API key
- 429: rate limit exceeded
- 502: upstream source error or unavailable
